title: TCD-040 Provenance-Pinned Independent Replay Evidence Bundle

blockers.detail: The current B0 evidence register still lacks proven controlled immutable retention for the exact source, testbank and user-guide bytes. Transient user-supplied bytes have been hash-matched and used for a local reconstruction, but that is not independent acquisition or controlled-retention proof.

GitHub Actions has no governance-approved non-secret immutable acquisition reference for the three frozen B0 artifacts, so the persisted replay generator cannot yet be executed there as an independently provenance-qualified replay.

constraints_not_blockers.detail: The raw source archive, testcase archive and copyrighted user guide are not copied into the public repository. The deterministic replay harness consumes caller-supplied hash-pinned B0 bytes instead.

resolved_blockers.resolution: A transparent provenance-pinned reconstruction harness for the existing bounded claim is persisted at tools/b3b04e1/replay_tcd040.py from commit 3b6a762bc677f53514ba3dc2ae8713931adc551f. It does not claim to be the lost original B3B04 authoring harness.

The harness deterministically regenerates checkpoint and trace payloads from the frozen source/testbank and records cryptographic hashes. A local hash-pinned execution was persisted at 47f4d332f53ea9bf47c5c2e4c03a926372c813c7.

The workunit uses the allowed deterministic-generator-plus-cryptographic-hashes route instead of committing multi-megabyte trace payloads. The canonical bundle manifest is integration/animo-b3/b3b04e1/REPLAY_MANIFEST.json.

reconstruction_evidence.trace_hash_caveat: These trace hashes belong to the explicit B3B04E1 transparent trace serialization. They are not claimed to reproduce the lost original B3B04 trace serialization hashes.

resume_condition: Resume qualification when a B0 Evidence Custodian supplies governance-approved immutable acquisition references for the exact source ZIP, testbank ZIP and user-guide PDF and the B0 controlled-storage proof gate passes. Then run the persisted deterministic reconstruction harness from those controlled bytes, run the ordinary B3B04E1 validator in full gate mode, persist the resulting replay hashes, and only if that gate passes create a new clean genuinely independent second-line reconsideration handoff.
